newsitem.title: UK: HSBC sets new peak on Asian stock rebound.
newsitem.headline: HSBC sets new peak on Asian stock rebound.

text.p: Shares in HSBC Holdings climbed to a fresh record peak after battered stock markets in the Far East rebounded, dealers said.
By 1003 GMT, the shares were up 29p, or 2.2 percent, to 1345-1/2p.
The Japanese stock market, down about 11 percent last week, led the recovery in the Far East, rising 4.7 percent overnight. The Hong Kong stock market climbed 0.74 percent.
HSBC shares hit an all-time high in Hong Kong amid market talk that a major brokerage house was considering a cover warrant issue on the stock.
Several brokerages, including Lehman and Panmure Gordon, have had buy recommendations on HSBC shares.
